question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.**

To poke one's nose into
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"To poke one's nose into"** is best expressed by the alternative 4) **"To interfere".**
 
• **"To poke one's nose into" **means to involve oneself in an intrusive or nosy manner into
